title: Virtual tape symbol
statement: Given a mode, a natural-number segment index $s$, a natural number $n$ of segments, a direction flag, and an optional Boolean read symbol, define an optional virtual symbol as follows. If the read counts as a character, return true when $s=0$ in unary-first mode, and otherwise return the read symbol. If it does not count as a character, then in the forward direction return no symbol when $s+1=n$, and false otherwise; in the reverse direction return no symbol when $s=0$, and true otherwise.
